hooks.name: ipc-contract-followups
hooks.description: Keep main handlers, the worker, preload and renderer calls in step with the contracts.

action.prompt: You changed the IPC or worker contract. Make sure every channel has a Zod-checked handler in apps/desktop/src/main/ipc, every worker message is handled in apps/desktop/src/worker, preload exposes nothing beyond window.alcyo.invoke and window.alcyo.on, and renderer calls still typecheck. Add a handler test for any new channel. Run pnpm typecheck and pnpm test.
